# Digital Seva Kendra

> Digital Seva Kendra is a local government-services and digital-documentation
> center in Shivmandir, Siliguri (West Bengal, India), helping residents apply
> for and manage essential cards, certificates, taxes, insurance and printing
> services. Proprietor: Mukunda Bhakta.

## At a glance

- **Business name:** Digital Seva Kendra
- **Proprietor:** Mukunda Bhakta
- **What it is:** A neighbourhood digital seva (service) center handling government
  documentation, certificates, tax payments, insurance and print/scan work.
- **Website:** https://mukundabhakta.page.gd/
- **Languages:** Bangla (default) and English

- **Phone:** +91 97332 38744

## Services

Digital Seva Kendra offers the following ten services:

- Insurance (All Vehicles)
- Voter Card & PAN Card
- Ration Card & Passport
- Panchayat Property Tax
- Land Revenue Tax (Khazna)
- MSME & Trade License
- SC/ST/OBC Certificate
- Digital Life Certificate
- ECHS Card & SPARSH
- Scan, Print & Lamination

## About

Digital Seva Kendra is a trusted local service center in Shivmandir, Siliguri,
run by proprietor Mukunda Bhakta. It helps residents of Shivmandir and the wider
Siliguri area complete everyday government and digital paperwork in one place —
from applying for PAN, Voter, Ration and ECHS cards to paying Panchayat property
tax and land revenue (Khazna), obtaining SC/ST/OBC and Digital Life certificates,
arranging vehicle insurance and MSME/Trade licenses, and handling passport,
scanning, printing and lamination work. The center serves customers in both
Bangla and English and is open every day from 9 AM to 8 PM. The quickest way to
reach Digital Seva Kendra is by phone or WhatsApp at +91 97332 38744.
